radiology_report:
Subject: Multiparametric MRI Prostate | Date: 20 February 2025 | Institution: Catharina Ziekenhuis, Eindhoven
Clinical indication: Persistent PSA elevation (12.0 ng/mL) and follow-up assessment.

FINDINGS:
Measuring 29.2 mL, the gland shows a focal hypointense focus in the left peripheral zone at mid-gland on T2-weighted sequences (approx. 12 × 8 × 10 mm). DWI/ADC reveals marked restricted diffusion. Early, intense enhancement appears on DCE. No capsular breach or seminal vesicle invasion. Pelvic lymph nodes remain unremarkable.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 5 lesion in the left peripheral zone. Prostate volume 29.2 mL yielding a PSA density of 0.411 ng/mL/mL. csPCa predicted probability 0.884623.

previous_notes.author: Dr. M. Jansen (GP)
previous_notes.text: On 01 Nov 2024, a review occurred after PSA climbed to 11.0 ng/mL in July. Persistent elevation alongside his age prompted scheduling a multiparametric MRI via the urology referral pathway. Attendance for imaging results was noted.
